steps.task: Implement activateCurrentParams() function that replaces the show path in saveToR2(). Handles two flows: no-preset (direct name prompt → create preset → set active) and has-preset (open modal → overwrite or create new → set active). Both flows call showsApi.setActivePreset() which triggers server-side cover regeneration.

sub_plan.description: Implement the two activation flows and modal confirm handler

steps.task: Implement activateCurrentParams(): if no currentPresetId, set showActivateModal=true with only 'new' option visible (or show inline prompt). If currentPresetId set, open modal with both options.

Implement confirmActivation(): for 'overwrite' choice — call presetsApi.update(currentPresetId, { params: JSON.stringify(params.value) }) then showsApi.setActivePreset(show.id, currentPresetId). For 'new' choice — call presetsApi.create(newPresetName, JSON.stringify(params.value), 'show') then showsApi.setActivePreset(show.id, newId). Update currentPresetId and refresh preset list via OverlayControls ref.
Add success flash message ('Parameters activated — cover is regenerating') and close modal on completion. Handle errors with flash.error().

decisions: showsApi.setActivePreset() already triggers do_regenerate_show_cover() on the backend — no new backend endpoint needed
presetsApi.create() returns the new preset with its ID — use that to update currentPresetId
Always call setActivePreset even when overwriting same preset ID, to force cover regeneration
knowledge.notes: Backend setActivePreset always calls do_regenerate_show_cover regardless of whether preset_id changed — this is the desired behavior.

output.summary: Completed: Implement activateCurrentParams() function that replaces the show path in saveTo
